# CHAMS Construction Pte. Ltd.

> Singapore-based commercial and interior construction company. BCA-registered
> and ISO 45001:2018 certified. Services span industrial blasting and protective
> painting, waterproofing, epoxy flooring, electrical and M&E works, plumbing
> and sanitary, interior fit-out and renovation, cement plastering, carpentry,
> glass and aluminium works, flooring installation, demolition and reinstatement,
> and skilled manpower supply. Trusted by Singapore statutory boards including
> JTC, LTA, HDB and PUB, and by semiconductor fabrication facilities.

## Contact
- Address: 238 Westwood Avenue, Singapore 648363
- Phone: +65 8117 4399
- Email: contact@chamsconstruction.com
- Area served: Singapore (island-wide), including Jurong, Tuas and central Singapore
